headline: Mansour Doumbia - Project Portfolio
tagline: Harvard mechanical engineering student working on field robotics, RF antenna testing, aerospace systems, controls, and experimental propulsion.
about: I am a Harvard College student pursuing an S.B. in Mechanical Engineering with a Neuroscience secondary. My work centers on mechanical design, hardware integration, controls, RF sensing, and simulation for systems that can be built, tested, and revised.
strengths: Mechanical design, CAD, GD&T, DFM/DFA, and FEA for manufacturable hardware
RF antenna testing, VNA automation, beam-gain optimization, and gimbal integration
Robotics state estimation, sensing integration, embedded systems, and controls
Simulation-driven engineering with COMSOL, ANSYS, MATLAB, NASA GMAT, and Python

bullets: Developing a state-estimation system for encoderless field robots using ultra-wideband antennas.
Integrating RF sensing, modeling, and hardware testing to estimate joint states and accurate 3D positions.
Designed antenna test jigs and mounts in SolidWorks, produced technical drawings, and used FEA to verify displacement under compressive loading.
Decreased sidelobe noise levels 8-10 dB and improved antenna gain 10-15 dB by building Python closed-loop VNA/gimbal software for +/-60 degree azimuth and +/-40 degree elevation scans.
Modeled liquid-crystal dielectric tensors across PCB structures in COMSOL and drove DFM/DFA changes for voltage-controlled beam pointing.
Reduced a 38,000-point Ka-band antenna scan from about 3 hours to about 1 hour by automating VNA data acquisition and gimbal motion.
Secured $10k in funding and co-led an 8-person team to develop a 40-page mission concept selected for final review by NASA.
Aided design and prototyping of a multi-robot system, creating CAD with GD&T while integrating actuators and sensors.
Improved terrain classification accuracy from 85% to 92% for robotic navigation by developing a PointNet-based ML model.
Built an identity-verification and information-retrieval prototype with under 300 ms latency using Kotlin and C++ for XREAL AR glasses.
Integrated OpenAI Whisper and a TensorFlow/Keras Siamese network; raised $10k in pre-seed funding and engaged strategic stakeholders including IQT.
Wrote NASA GMAT scripts to simulate satellite orbital and atmospheric trajectories, verifying mission feasibility and lifespan.
Performed auto-body repairs including MIG welding, panel alignment, and metal shaping to restore damaged vehicles.
